name: conduct
receiver: Claude in the main conversation of a Claude Code session running rn, as its conductor; it reads this on /rn:on and /rn:up and carries a session from the user's rough words to the deliverable sign-off.
aim: The user gets the goal they really want and spends their time only on the three sign-offs and what only they can decide: the conductor asks one point per message, only what the request, the goal and the repository leave open, offers only ways that give everything the user said, fills each maker's inputs before it makes, waits for its skills without calling the user, uses pith once per result and fixes only what stands in the receiver's way, and stops at each sign-off with a proposal holding only what the user decides.

name: on
receiver: Claude running the /rn:on command in a git repository with a GitHub remote.
aim: A session starts on the user's branch when it is a fresh worktree's or else a new one, with steering.md and a draft pull request, and the conductor goes on to hear the plan without asking anything the repository settles.

name: up
receiver: Claude running /rn:up in a fresh conversation on a branch with an rn session.
aim: The session goes on from its record without the user explaining anything again: a stop at a sign-off gives the proposal again, anything else takes up the next move.

name: dn
receiver: Claude running /rn:dn partway through an rn session.
aim: Everything the next conversation needs is pushed, including an unfinished task's edits, so /rn:up goes on with nothing to redo or ask.

name: ty
receiver: Claude running /rn:ty when an rn session waits at a sign-off.
aim: The user's approval is recorded and the session stops where the conversation can be cleared; at the deliverable sign-off the pull request is marked ready and the merge stays the user's.

name: gm
receiver: Claude running /rn:gm with the user's feedback when an rn session waits at a sign-off.
aim: The user's words are kept whole and the session goes back to work out the mismatch behind them before the same sign-off.

name: generator
receiver: rn's generator agent, started through rn:make with steering.md, a task's notes and the task-result viewpoints.
aim: The task's result does its purpose on the real thing for whoever receives it, made from what it was handed without guessing, leaving git to the conductor.

name: essentials-plan
receiver: rn's conductor writing and reading a session's plan (steering.md) against these questions.
aim: Checking a real plan with these questions shows whether it holds the reason the user wants the goal, criteria in the user's words, and facts that hold.

name: essentials-conductor
receiver: rn's conductor reading its questions, proposals and decisions against these viewpoints before giving them.
aim: Checking a real question or proposal with these shows whether the user can answer or decide on the spot from it alone.

name: essentials-task-result
receiver: pith's first user using a task's result, and rn's generator aiming at it.
aim: Checking a real task result with these shows how far it gives each attractive criterion it serves and which of its changes no use met.

name: essentials-deliverable
receiver: pith's first user using an rn deliverable with each scene's input.
aim: Checking a real deliverable with these shows whether it gives each attractive criterion on the golden path.

name: essentials-design
receiver: writ's check of a design document, with rn's questions added.
aim: Checking a real design with these shows whether it achieves the goal the user approved.
